english.title: Use a motor vehicle - mirrors not fitted
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was not fitted with **(..SPECIFY MIRROR(S)..) as specified in Item 6 of the table to Regulation 33 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and use) Regulations 1986.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 33(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

not fitted with mirrors

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) See H3329 for mirrors not fitted to a bus.
(ii) See H3330 for mirrors not fitted to a goods vehicle with a maximum gross weight exceeding 3500kg.
(iii) See H3331 for mirrors not fitted to an agricultural goods vehicle with maximum gross weight exceeding 12000kg.
(iv) See regulation 33(7) for meaning of 'mirror'
(v) Regulation 33 also applies conditions and requirements in relation to mirrors fitted, it does not apply to road rollers.
(vi) Instead of complying with regulation 33(1)-(4) a vehicle may comply with the relevant community directive referred to in regulation 33(5).
(vii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end
of document for wording.
(viii) See also offence wordings: H201 and H202.
(ix) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied
